title: Add Back to Top
content: Create back to top button appearing after scroll. Button: fixed bottom-6 right-6 w-12 h-12 bg-blue-600 text-white rounded-full shadow-lg. Icon: ArrowUp centered. Show/hide: hidden initially, show after scrolling down 300px. Click handler: window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: "smooth" }). Transition: opacity and transform for smooth appear/disappear. Hover state: scale-110 or darker background. z-index: z-40 to stay above content but below modals.

variants.simple: Create a back to top button that appears on scroll.
variants.detailed: Create back to top button appearing after scroll. Button: fixed bottom-6 right-6 w-12 h-12 bg-blue-600 text-white rounded-full shadow-lg. Icon: ArrowUp centered. Show/hide: hidden initially, show after scrolling down 300px. Click handler: window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: "smooth" }). Transition: opacity and transform for smooth appear/disappear. Hover state: scale-110 or darker background. z-index: z-40 to stay above content but below modals.
variants.advanced: Create polished back-to-top button with progress indicator. Show logic: useState for visibility, useEffect with scroll event listener (throttled with requestAnimationFrame or lodash throttle). Show threshold: configurable, default 300px from top. Button: fixed bottom-6 right-6 z-40. Button styling: w-12 h-12 rounded-full shadow-lg transition-all duration-300 ease-out. Hidden state: opacity-0 translate-y-4 pointer-events-none. Visible state: opacity-100 translate-y-0. Colors: bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white, or bg-white hover:bg-gray-50 text-gray-700 border. Icon: ArrowUp w-5 h-5 centered. Click handler: window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: "smooth" }), or use scrollIntoView on body. Progress ring: SVG circle around button showing scroll progress (stroke-dashoffset based on scroll percentage). Mobile considerations: bottom-4 right-4, larger touch target, avoid overlapping with mobile navigation. Accessibility: aria-label="Back to top", focus-visible:ring-2. Animation enhancement: icon animates up slightly on hover. Tooltip: optional "Back to top" tooltip on hover. Props: threshold, smooth (boolean), showProgress, position (bottom-left, bottom-right, etc), offset from edge. Optional: show current scroll percentage as text.
